43: ANNA. Where are they? Where are they? Oh, my God! [opening the door.] Husband! Antosha! Anton! [hurriedly, to Marya.] It's all your fault. Dawdling! Dawdling!—"I want a pin—I want a scarf." [Runs to the window and calls.] Anton, where are you going? Where are you going? What! He has come? The Inspector? He has a moustache? What kind of a moustache?
42: All go out. Anna Andreyevna and Marya Antonovna rush in on the stage.
41: CAPTAIN. Anton Antonovich, that's the hat-box, not your hat.
40: CAPTAIN. God knows. Yesterday there was a fight outside the town. He went to restore order and was brought back drunk.
39: CAPTAIN. Yes. GOVERNOR. How could you allow him to get drunk?
38: CAPTAIN. He has gone off on the fire engine. GOVERNOR. And Prokhorov is drunk?
36: GOVERNOR. Well, listen, Stepan Ilyich. An official has come from St. Petersburg. What have you done about it? CAPTAIN. What you told me to. I sent Sergeant Pugovichyn with policemen to clean the street.
35: CAPTAIN. Why, I was just outside the gate.
34: Enter the Police Captain. GOVERNOR. Hello, Stepan Ilyich, where the dickens have you been keeping yourself? What do you mean by acting that way?
33: BOBCHINSKY. Oh, that doesn't matter. I'll follow the cab on foot—on foot. I just want to peep through a crack—so—to see that manner of his—how he acts.
32: BOBCHINSKY. And me—me, too. Let me come, too, Anton Antonovich. GOVERNOR. No, no, Bobchinsky, it won't do. Besides there is not enough room in the cab.
31: SVISTUNOV. Well, they brought him back this morning dead drunk. They poured two buckets of water over him, but he hasn't sobered up yet. GOVERNOR [clutching his head with both hands]. For Heaven's sake! Go out on duty quick—or, no, run up to my room, do you hear? And fetch my sword and my new hat. Now, Piotr Ivanovich, [to Dobchinsky] come.
30: SVISTUNOV. Prokhorov is in somebody's house and can't go on duty just now. GOVERNOR. Why so?
28: GOVERNOR. Go out on the street—or, no, stop—go and bring—why, where are the others? Why are you alone? Didn't I give orders for Prokhorov to be here? Where is Prokhorov?
27: GOVERNOR. Well, is the cab ready? SVISTUNOV. Yes, sir.
26: The Governor, Bobchinsky, Dobchinsky, and Sergeant Svistunov.
25: AMMOS. Well, my mind's at ease. Who's going to visit the court? Supposing he does look at the papers, he'll wish he had left them alone. I have been on the bench fifteen years, and when I take a look into a report, I despair. King Solomon in all his wisdom could not tell what is true and what is not true in it. The Judge, the Superintendent of Charities, the School Inspector, and Postmaster go out and bump up against the Sergeant in the doorway as the latter returns.
24: ARTEMY. Nightcaps! Nonsense! The patients were ordered to have oatmeal soup. Instead of that there's such a smell of cabbage in all the corridors that you've got to hold your nose.
23: AMMOS. What have you got to be afraid of? Put clean nightcaps on the patients and the thing's done.
22: ARTEMY. Let's go, let's go, Ammos Fiodorovich. We may really get into trouble.
20: GOVERNOR. Go instantly to the Police Captain—or, no, I'll want you. Tell somebody to send him here as quickly as possibly and then come back.
16: GOVERNOR. So much the better. It's easier to pump things out of a young man. It's tough if you've got a hardened old devil to deal with. But a young man is all on the surface. You, gentlemen, had better see to your end of things while I go unofficially, by myself, or with Dobchinsky here, as though for a walk, to see that the visitors that come to town are properly accommodated. Here, Svistunov. [To one of the Sergeants.]
15: BOBCHINSKY. Yes, about twenty-three or four at the most.
14: AMMOS. No, no. First send the chief magistrate, then the clergy, then the merchants. That's what it says in the book. The Acts of John the Freemason. GOVERNOR. No, no, leave it to me. I have been in difficult situations before now. They have passed off all right, and I was even rewarded with thanks. Maybe the Lord will help us out this time, too. [Turns to Bobchinsky.] You say he's a young man?
13: ARTEMY. What do you think, Anton Antonovich, hadn't we better go in state to the inn?
11: GOVERNOR. Two weeks! [Aside.] Holy Fathers and saints preserve me! In those two weeks I have flogged the wife of a non-commissioned officer, the prisoners were not given their rations, the streets are dirty as a pothouse—a scandal, a disgrace! [Clutches his head with both hands.]
10: DOBCHINSKY. Two weeks. He came on St. Vasili's day.
9: BOBCHINSKY. In the same room that the officers quarreled in when they passed through here last year. GOVERNOR. How long has he been here?
8: GOVERNOR. The Lord have mercy on us sinners! In what room is he staying? DOBCHINSKY. Room number 5 near the stairway.
6: BOBCHINSKY. It's he, it's he, it's he—why, he's so alert, he scrutinized everything. He saw that Dobchinsky and I were eating salmon—chiefly on account of Dobchinsky's stomach—and he looked at our plates so hard that I was frightened to death.
4: DOBCHINSKY. It is, though. Why, he doesn't pay his bills and he doesn't leave. Who else can it be? And his postchaise is ordered for Saratov.
2: GOVERNOR [terrified]. Great God! What's that you're saying. It can't be he.
0: BOBCHINSKY. Why, the official who you were notified was coming, the Inspector.
